no_holdout_access: this draft has not read heldout labels or scored current cases

research_questions.H1: Does qualified retrieval find more relevant decision-time historical evidence than recency?
research_questions.H2: Does memory-supported synthesis improve supported evidence/contradiction/omission quality without unsupported critical claims?
research_questions.H3: Optional future separately registered forecast study; disabled in this protocol
research_questions.H4: Can pinned exact retrieval reproduce and meet declared cost/latency requirements?

corpus_gate: C0 chooses actual qualified sources/subjects/clock precision/rights; W2C opportunity denominator includes failed/abstained/not-observed; fit-eligible rows independent of outcome success. No promised sample size or population coverage.
freeze_before_labels: answerability labels and decision-time evidence annotation guide

trial_budget.tuning: one declared tuning partition; no test outcome access
trial_budget.additional_challenger: new trial/version, budget and untouched holdout required; retain failed/contaminated trials

splits: chronological by decision cutoff; all shared economic episode/source-revision siblings remain same split. Block by predeclared session intervals, plus leave-subject/event holdout when genuine multiple qualified subjects exist. Boundary rows whose full feature/registered label intervals cross the split are purged; embargo is registered before labels.
blindness: reviewers rate condition-randomized source/evidence packets without method/provider identity or later outcome lens. Preserve necessary decision-time context. Any anonymization affecting financial question is documented and identical across conditions; current LLM pretraining contamination remains disclosed.
primary_unit: query task nested within economic episode; paired methods on same task; cluster paired effects by predeclared economic episode/session block. Never count revisions/fires/neighbors as independent episodes.

primary_metrics.retrieval: decision-relevant evidence coverage at fixed k, judged against permitted decision-time source set; report relevance precision and omissions separately
primary_metrics.support: supported material claims / all material claims; critical unsupported-claim count; contradiction recall and decision-relevant omission count
primary_metrics.abstention: answerable answered correctly, answerable abstained, unanswerable abstained, unanswerable asserted; all remain denominator
primary_metrics.utility: blind analyst utility and time-to-evidence as secondary after correctness gate

proposed_decision_margins.critical_unsupported_claims: any observed critical unsupported claim blocks positive supported-usefulness disposition until bounded repair and fresh untouched evaluation; do not remove failed task
proposed_decision_margins.positive_gain_confidence_rule: 95% cluster-aware confidence interval lower bound above zero AND point gain >=0.10; only if enough genuine independent clusters for estimator
proposed_decision_margins.support_noninferiority: lower 95% clustered bound on support-precision difference >= -0.02; gate may still be insufficient if sample cannot support interval
proposed_decision_margins.critical_definition: claim could materially change research interpretation, violates source/time/rights or asserts unsupported efficacy/trade action; annotate guide before scoring

uncertainty: publish raw paired counts/economic episode counts, cluster definition, missingness, disagreement and intervals. Effective N remains not_estimated unless a justified accepted estimator exists. Too few independent clusters, empty qualified corpus or immature evidence returns INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never PASS/NO_GO by manufactured power.
prospective: existing admitted evaluation/source owners record issued/abstained/failed opportunities and original hypotheses/versions; preserve mature/pending/censored states. No timer-only claim, restarted August window, retroactive issuance or LLM historical-ignorance claim.
mandatory_full_program: all three consumers plus entitled three-mode user path, cross-domain revisions/second subject, source rights/recovery and explicit pending obligations remain separate acceptance rows; no prediction gain requirement manufactured to close observation product.

design_authority.basis: Chairman-assigned end-to-end program; bounded principal scientific adjudication
design_authority.scope: Fix the proposed method and decision margins before task annotation or later-outcome access. This does not grant source usage, training, promotion, runtime admission or efficacy.

fixed_comparison_baseline.source_basis: retained house macro output state; not constituent-source truth
fixed_comparison_baseline.formula: d=(abs(gq-gc)/2 + abs(iq-ic)/2 + I(quadq!=quadc) + I(liquidityq!=liquidityc) + I(cycleq!=cyclec))/5; each of five fixed terms has weight 0.2.
fixed_comparison_baseline.missingness: All five coordinates required. Unknown, missing, nonfinite, out-of-domain or incomparable coordinates return an explicit comparison gap; do not drop dimensions, zero-fill, refit or change denominator per candidate.
fixed_comparison_baseline.numeric_convention: owner_binary64_exact_decimal_to_q18_half_even.v1; preserve original binary64 hex and exact Decimal provenance, q18 half-even coordinate conversion independent of ambient Decimal context; deterministic registered Decimal arithmetic and final q18 half-even distance rounding required before evaluation.
fixed_comparison_baseline.rights: Existing owner must allow the actual comparison purpose before private reading; absence of a training prohibition is not comparison permission. Recheck disclosure rights before response/cache.
fixed_comparison_baseline.fit_obligation: Retained training_eligible=false remains false. Fixed scales are not fitted parameters or a fabricated training cohort. P2 training-only fitting is a separate interface and must refuse ineligible inputs.
fixed_comparison_baseline.tie_break: distance_q18 ascending, then stable context_id ascending; source-revision siblings remain the same economic episode for exclusions and splits.

required_before_evaluation_admission: exact owner source/rights/usage profile and policy version
outcome-blind expected opportunity census and population membership digest
exact query context set and temporal cutoffs
chronological train/tune/test membership hashes and boundary-purge/embargo intervals
decision-time evidence annotation and answerability guide hash
independent reviewer assignment and disagreement-resolution rule
blind randomization seed and condition allocation hash
executable method and each baseline source digest
task question list and source evidence set hash
fit artifact admission if any fitted challenger is introduced
explicit approval that all preregistration fields are complete before annotation or label reads
historical_clock_claim: Design creation occurred at design_frozen_at. Any retrospective application is historical hypothetical analysis, never an original issued system output.

pre_admission_review_correction.reason: Independent scientific review found the draft protocol had squared (L2) numeric terms and different method/unit identifiers while the already accepted fixed baseline specified absolute (L1) terms. Corrected to the accepted method; no method change or label access.
